```

```

## fit the standard model with meta-uncertainty and meta-bias
```{r}
# model = cmdstanr::cmdstan_model(here::here("Stanmodels","Heurestic models","Emperical dataanalysis","hierarchical","full_model3.stan"))
model = cmdstanr::cmdstan_model(here::here("Stanmodels","Heurestic models","Emperical dataanalysis","hierarchical","lapse","full_model3_lapse.stan"))


dd = df %>% 
  mutate(subject = as.numeric(as.factor(subject))) %>% 
  filter(Trialtype == "Main", scale == "conf") %>% drop_na()


datastan = list(N = nrow(dd),
                S = length(unique(dd$ID)),
                S_id = as.numeric(as.factor(dd$ID)),
                a = dd$Y,
                RT = dd$RT,
                D = dd$D,
                C = dd$Confidence,
                X = dd$X * dd$D,
                XD = dd$X,
                minRT = min(dd$RT),
                ACC = dd$Correct,
                interval = dd$interval)


fit <-model$sample(
  data = datastan,
  refresh = 10,
  iter_sampling = 1000,
  iter_warmup = 1000,
  adapt_delta = 0.95,
  max_treedepth = 12,
  init  = 0,
  parallel_chains = 4)


fit$save_object(here::here("Experimental analysis","Heurestic models","saved models","saved models hier",paste0("fit_hier3_lapse.rds")))

```


```{r}
models = list.files(here::here("Experimental analysis","Heurestic models","saved models","saved models hier"), full.names = T)

fits = list()
loos = list()
for(model in models[1:6]){
  fit = readRDS(model)
  fits[[str_remove(str_remove(str_split(model, "/")[[1]][9],".rds"),"fit_")]] = fit  
  
  loo = fit$loo("log_lik")
  
  loos[[str_remove(str_remove(str_split(model, "/")[[1]][9],".rds"),"fit_")]] = loo
  
}

modelcompar = data.frame(loo::loo_compare(loos)) %>% rownames_to_column("models")


fit_hier <- readRDS(models[grepl(modelcompar$models[1],models)])
```


```{r, fig.width=16,fig.height=12}
dia_hier(fit_hier, dd)
```
